query:
SELECT tm1.teamid AS "teamid!"
          FROM teammembers AS tm1
         INNER JOIN teammembers AS tm2 ON tm1.teamid = tm2.teamid
         INNER JOIN teams ON tm1.teamid = teams.id
         WHERE tm1.userid = $1
           AND tm1.deleteat = 0
           AND tm2.userid = $2
           AND tm2.deleteat = 0
           AND teams.deleteat = 0
